description: Run the full ghost-qa Deep Browser Inspection against a running localhost app: crawls internal routes on Desktop 1440x900, Tablet 768x1024 and Mobile 375x812 under light + dark colour schemes, safely exercises interactive controls, and runs the 8-Trap Engine (console/framework runtime, network/asset integrity, layout/geometry/collision, WCAG accessibility + keyboard focus, Core Web Vitals performance, link integrity, SEO/metadata, theme parity). Returns the Self-Healing Bug Report plus the QA Health Score (0-100, grade A+ to F) — fix every critical/major issue and re-audit until the score is 95+ before declaring the task done. Save the returned report JSON as before.json for ghost_qa_compare.

url.description: Target URL of the running app, e.g. http://localhost:3000

viewport.description: Viewports to test (default all: desktop + tablet + mobile)

name: ghost_qa_audit_url
